name: Serena Booth
title: Assistant Professor of Computer Science
fitReason: New-2025 Assistant Professor with strong technical work on how human feedback shapes sequential agent/robot behavior. A method-focused Human-AI/HRI backup under the new-faculty priority, with current physical learned execution and external-master visit access unverified.

physicalEvidence.summary: The full April 2026 revision of Influencing Humans to Conform to Preference Models for RLHF compares partial-return, regret and change-in-expected-return preference models, trains reward functions from human trajectory comparisons, and tests interface/training interventions. Delivery and transfer domains are grid-world simulations, including a stochastic-transition variant; there is no physical robot execution. The 2026 HRI kitchen-intention study’s primary abstract adds robot-collaboration context, but its full methods were unavailable and are not used to claim hardware. Earlier robot demonstrations do not establish a current Brown apparatus.

shortVisit.summary: The live personal page tells external prospective PhD students to use Brown admissions and potential postdocs to email. It provides no separate outside-master visiting or summer-research invitation. Department-wide visiting-opportunity listings inspected are undergraduate programs and include stale 2023 summer dates, so they do not establish master’s access.

unknowns: Summer 2027 availability, project duration, remote participation, funding and current Brown robot access remain unknown. The PhD/postdoc guidance is scoped recruitment information, not a blanket no-visitors statement.

The RLHF study finds intervention effects that vary across preference models and domains; privileged reward information is explicitly a proof-of-concept condition. No universal alignment improvement or deployed robot safety guarantee is inferred.

Brown institutional policy is reused at 2026-10-01T01:28:13Z. External enrolled graduate researchers may use a sponsored Visiting Research Fellow appointment with degree linkage, Graduate School/ISSS approvals and designated insurance. Brown’s Student Intern category is undergraduate-only.

The saved guidance estimates 120–150 days, allows personal support and lists a $225 initial VRF charge for stays of six months or less under the September 2026 schedule. The support threshold, insurance premium, 2027 charges and individual appointment must be rechecked; no university funding or faculty vacancy is promised.
Public robot research does not confirm current equipment access, a summer 2027 offer or host availability.
